title: Superman Returns Prequel #1 2 3 4 Complete Set DC 2006 Lex Luthor Lois Lane
conditionDescription: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Complete set of 4: Superman Returns Prequel #1, #2, #3 and #4 of 4 (August 2006), DC Comics - prequel to the Superman Returns film. Story by Bryan Singer, Michael Dougherty and Dan Harris.

- #1 Krypton to Earth: script by Jimmy Palmiotti and Justin Gray, art by Ariel Olivetti.
- #2 Ma Kent: script by Marc Andreyko, art and cover by Karl Kerschl.
- #3 Lex Luthor: script by Justin Gray and Jimmy Palmiotti, art by Rick Leonardi.
- #4 Lois Lane: script by Marc Andreyko, art by Ivan Dias.

Direct sales, $3.99 cover price each. Back covers: #1 and #2 Disney/Pixar Cars videogame ads; #3 and #4 Superman Returns: The Videogame ads.

Condition: all bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
